royal-handcrafted-raw-silk-kurta-embroid.title: Royal Handcrafted Raw Silk Kurta with Embroidered Nehru Jacket
royal-handcrafted-raw-silk-kurta-embroid.shortDescription: Festive Raw Silk Kurta Set with Embroidered Nehru Jacket
royal-handcrafted-raw-silk-kurta-embroid.description: Regal festive ensemble featuring a pure raw silk full-sleeve kurta paired with an intricately thread-embroidered Mandarin collar Nehru jacket and churidar pajama.

indigo-dark-washed-stretchable-slim-fit-.title: Indigo Dark Washed Stretchable Slim Fit Denim Jeans
indigo-dark-washed-stretchable-slim-fit-.description: Engineered with 98% cotton and 2% elastane for optimum 4-way stretch and retention. Features subtle whiskers, mid-rise contour waistband, and antique brass hardware.

chanderi-floral-anarkali-kurti-palazzo-o.title: Chanderi Floral Anarkali Kurti with Flared Palazzo & Organza Dupatta
chanderi-floral-anarkali-kurti-palazzo-o.description: Step into effortless grace with this 3-piece festive ethnic set. Features delicate gotta patti hand embroidery on the yoke, flared Anarkali silhouette, matching palazzo, and a gossamer organza dupatta.

heritage-banarasi-katan-silk-wedding-sar.title: Heritage Banarasi Katan Silk Wedding Saree with Pure Zari Border
heritage-banarasi-katan-silk-wedding-sar.shortDescription: Authentic Handloom Katan Silk Wedding Saree with Zari
heritage-banarasi-katan-silk-wedding-sar.description: Traditional hand-woven pure Katan Silk saree from the master weavers of Varanasi. Adorned with floral jaal motifs and an opulent golden zari border and pallu. Includes matching unstitched blouse piece.

supima-cotton-heavyweight-crew-neck-tshi.title: Supima Cotton Heavyweight Crew Neck Oversized T-Shirt
supima-cotton-heavyweight-crew-neck-tshi.description: 240 GSM pre-shrunk heavyweight Supima cotton tee with double-needle ribbed collar and dropped shoulders. Modern streetwear aesthetic built for all-day comfort.

royal-oxford-pure-cotton-slim-fit-casual.title: Royal Oxford Pure Cotton Slim Fit Casual Shirt
royal-oxford-pure-cotton-slim-fit-casual.shortDescription: 100% Pure Oxford Cotton Slim Fit Shirt
royal-oxford-pure-cotton-slim-fit-casual.description: Crafted from 100% long-staple combed cotton, this Oxford button-down shirt offers unmatched breathability and a sharp silhouette. Perfect for formal meetings and casual evenings.
